A HUMAN ERROR WAS MADE IN OPENING AN INCORRECT VALVE AND AN ELECTRONIC / MECHANICAL OVERSPILL PROTECTION DEVICE MALFUNCTIONED TO ALLOW THE ACCIDENTAL DISCHARGE OF DIESEL FUEL. (FOUR ABOVE GROUND STORAGE TANKS (ASTS) ARE LOCATED IN A CONTAINMENT BERM. TANK NO. 1 WAS OVERFILLED IN AN ATTEMPT TO FILL AN ADJACENT TANK (NO. 2). TANK NO. 1 WAS NEARLY FULL AND SPILLED OVER DUE TO THE ERROR AND MALFUNCTION.
